title: CSTrans-OPU: An FPGA-based Overlay Processor with Full Compilation for Transformer Networks via Sparsity Exploration
problem: Existing overlay processors for transformer networks neglect sparsity exploration while sparse accelerators suffer from inefficient resource utilization with separate computation parts, and mainstream compilers for instruction generation are complex and demand significant engineering effort.
motivation: Efficient transformer inference acceleration is essential for deploying large language models with reduced latency and energy consumption.
method: CSTrans-OPU customizes a multi-precision PE array with DSP-packing for unified computation format with full resource utilization. It introduces sorting and computation mode selection modules to explore token sparsity. A user-friendly compiler handles model parsing, operation fusion, quantization, and instruction generation directly from model files.
key_novelty: First overlay processor for transformer networks that systematically explores network sparsity within a unified reconfigurable architecture.
contributions: FPGA overlay processor with customized multi-precision PE array and DSP-packing for unified transformer computation
Sparsity exploration mechanism via sorting and computation mode selection for token-level efficiency
End-to-end compiler automating model parsing, fusion, quantization, and instruction generation from model files
Demonstrated 4.28× latency improvement and 4.94× energy efficiency gain over prior accelerators
